title: Treesa-Gayatri Duo Set for Denmark Open Round of 32 Clash
indian_angle: Indian women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand are set to compete in a significant international tournament.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand will face Chinese Taipei’s Yan Fei Chen and Hsieh Pei Shan in the women’s doubles round of 32 at the Denmark Open 2026 today.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has formed a new Athletes Committee to ensure better representation and welfare for Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2nd, aiming to provide a stronger voice and support system for Indian badminton players.

title: National Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: India's top junior shuttlers are currently at a national coaching camp in Guwahati, preparing for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian junior players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Implements New 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has introduced a significant rule change, implementing the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic events.
summary: The BAI has announced the implementation of a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, effective from June 30, 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India conducted an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course to enhance the skill set of Indian badminton coaches.
summary: The BAI successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, focusing on developing coaching expertise.
